free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the presence of a PI-RADS 5 lesion (12 x 9 mm) in the left peripheral zone and a concerning PSA velocity of 1.09 ng/mL/yr. This high-grade imaging finding, combined with the rising PSA trend, strongly supports sampling, despite the DRE being reported as normal. The statistical prior favored biopsy, and the retrieved evidence converges on this recommendation.
